summary: Bulk Child→User and Person-Merge features fully verified. All 24 backend tests pass. Frontend UI shows both new panels with all required elements. Person-merge overview returns 30 clusters with expected summary values. Albin cluster correctly combines child candidate, restored screenshot candidate, and active user (3 members). Bulk child-to-user preview returns 3 restoreable items (Anuar, Emma, Albin) with suggested emails under restore.bidblitz.local. No regression in existing features.

issues: Cookie banner overlays lower-right area (known infrastructure caveat, does not block functionality)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk Child→User and Person-Merge features fully verified. The features are accessible via Admin Wallet page > Legacy Restore tab. Bulk Child→User panel allows selecting multiple child candidates, entering email domain, previewing with auto-generated emails, and confirming with admin password. Person-Merge panel shows cluster summary (30 clusters, 6 with active users, 6 with child candidates, 3 with possible real) and allows viewing cluster details with all members. Albin cluster correctly shows 3 members: child candidate (child:child_2a880974de5f), restored candidate (albinkrasniqi11@icloud.com), and active user. All existing features (review enrichment, filters, bulk restore, history, child-to-user single preview) still work.
